Per Law360, the report treats AI software costs as overhead that can be passed on as a disbursement only when tied to a specific client matter and disclosed. Lawyers need not tell clients about AI use for purely administrative tasks, provided fees are unaffected. NYSBA president Taa Grays says the guidance is meant to help attorneys use AI ethically.

The court found the citation unsatisfactory but held it did not affect the outcome, refused permission to amend and dismissed the judicial review. The claimant was 14 and the alleged offence occurred when he was 11.

stories.hook: Professor Dapo Akande elected to the International Court of Justice as the UK's first judge since 2017
